summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO on May 26, 2026, selling 7.5 million units at $10.00 each for gross proceeds of $75 million, and a simultaneous private placement of 297,500 units to the sponsor for $2.975 million. Net proceeds of $75.75 million were placed in trust for public shareholders. This is a routine IPO completion filing for a blank-check SPAC; it does not trigger a special situations category as it reflects standard startup funding, not a de-SPAC transaction.
